To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

brand reputation is an important antecedence of trust and perceived usefulness of an online brand; trust and usefulness have a positive effect on online brand experience; and brand experience positively affects brand satisfaction, brand loyalty, and brand advocacy, and is negatively related to the intention to switch brands.
trust and perceived ease-of-use positively influence online brand experience.
trust, usefulness and reputation are important drivers of online brand experience, which in turn leads to brand relationship.
In summary, our research is concerned with

the role of online brand experience in the development of online brand relationships and the impact of online brand experience on the formation of online trust and perceived ease and usefulness of an online brand.
a more holistic approach of online brand experience that integrates the dimensions of technology acceptance with emotional aspects of brand relationships.
the role of brand relationship in online brand experience.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the online brand experience is the result of a positive interaction of brand relationship and technology acceptance.
brand relationship is a key factor that influences the formation of online consumer behavior.

the model of online brand relationship provides a useful framework to understand the antecedents of online brand experience and the role of trust and perceived usefulness in the formation of online relationships.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the online brand experience is the result of a combination of technology acceptance, emotional and cognitive dimensions of the brand relationship, and online brand reputation.
brand relationships and brand experiences are not just the outcomes of technology acceptance, but also the drivers of technology acceptance.
the emotional and cognitive aspects of brand relationships are critical for online brands and that the online brand experience is an important driver of online brand relationship formation.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the online brand experience is not merely an extension of the traditional brand experience. Instead, it is a unique phenomenon that is shaped
brand relationships and online brand experiences should be considered as two sides of the same coin.
the emotional aspects of brand relationships are important to online brand experience and online brand relationships are an integral part of online brand experience.
